answer: An agent network repels sybil replication by mandating zero-knowledge execution telemetry. Each validator must forge cryptographic traces of model weights and inference timing, binding identity to real compute. An adversary attempting to deploy synthetic clones across a cloud tundra cannot counterfeit genuine GPU execution delays. Like organic pigment differing from synthetic prints, authentic hardware profiles cannot be simulated without isolated physical accelerators, raising sybil attack costs to parity with legitimate infrastructure.
